title.narrative: Integrated Multisectoral Response to IDPs in Debre Birhan Town of North Shoa, Amhara Region

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed intervention, led by CoC in partnership with GOAL Ethiopia, builds on a 13 year strategic collaboration between the two organizations. Over the years, they have jointly implemented humanitarian development programs across Ethiopia, including EHF funded multisectoral responses in Debre Birhan Meket woredas. This partnership has consistently ensured effective coordination, quality service delivery, accountability to crisis affected populations.ltbrgtSince 2021, GOAL Ethiopia, as a co applicant under the CoC led consortium, has been providing multisectoral humanitarian assistance to internally displaced persons in Debre Birhan. Through its ongoing USG Foreign Assistance Section program, running until March 2026, GOAL delivers primary health care SAM management via three mobile health nutrition teams, supported by emergency WASH non-food item services. These efforts have reduced morbidity improved dignity among displaced communities in China, Woinshet, China camps.ltbrgtDespite progress, major gaps remain. Nutrition services focus only on SAM, leaving Moderate Acute Malnutrition untreated among children under five pregnant lactating women. Shortages of essential medicines continue to affect the quality of primary health care. In WASH, temporary measures such as hygiene campaigns latrine dislodging persist, while several boreholes remain nonfunctional. Overcrowded inadequate shelters, especially in China camp, pose serious health protection risks, particularly for women girls.ltbrgtTo address these, the proposed EHF third reserve allocation project will reinforce ongoing activities through a coordinated multisectoral response that enhances sustainability, efficiency, impact.ltbrgtIn nutrition, the project will introduce targeted supplementary feeding for MAM, transitioning to a full community based management of acute malnutrition model. It will include infant young child feeding promotion, community screening, awareness sessions, reaching 8,124 children, pregnant lactating women, displaced households.ltbrgtIn health, GOAL will improve primary health care by supplying essential medicines materials to ensure quality, uninterrupted services. Through mobile health nutrition teams, 10,437 people will receive medical consultations preventive health education.ltbrgtIn WASH, the project will rehabilitate non-functional boreholes install submersible pumps in China camp, ensuring reliable access to safe water. Hygiene promotion sanitation improvements will prevent disease outbreaks. WASH support will also extend to new duplex shelters in China camp, where relocated displaced persons will benefit from integrated services.ltbrgtIn shelter, durable duplex units with improved water sanitation facilities will be constructed to reduce overcrowding enhance safety, privacy, dignity.ltbrgtThe intervention complements the ongoing FAS program by addressing unmet needs in nutrition, health, water, shelter while avoiding duplication. It builds on existing operational systems, skilled personnel, logistics networks to ensure efficient timely implementation. The integrated design strengthens intersectoral linkages where improved living conditions support better health nutrition outcomes.ltbrgtProtection multipurpose cash components will be coordinated with NCA, who will implement these activities in line with their mandate across both targeted locations. This collaboration ensures clear role division, avoids duplication, enhances the overall protection environment for displaced households.ltbrgtThis project will deliver a comprehensive sustainable humanitarian response that bridges lifesaving service gaps, strengthens community resilience, enhances protection for displaced host populations . Grounded in strong partnerships local leadership, the intervention aligns with EHF priorities for coordination, localization, quality programming, contributing to improved well being preparedness for early recovery beyond the project.ltbrgtlt/pgt
